description: A complete six-page Divi 5 website for a solar installer, electrician, roofing company, home-energy or any trade that sells a big home upgrade, ready to make your own. Home, Solar Panels, Savings and Pricing, Installations, About and Contact share one warm, trustworthy identity: cream backgrounds, midnight navy text, a burnt-orange accent, Poppins type and keycap buttons that press on hover. Every section is built from proven, validated recipes and a single design language and style kit, so buttons, accordions, forms and type match on every page, on desktop, tablet and phone. A full-bleed photo hero, benefit icons, a system bento, customer quotes, a four-step explainer, buy-versus-lease comparison, three priced packages, a savings band, installation gallery, before-and-after, quote slider, team grid and a company story are all in place. Names, prices, savings and reviews are sample copy: swap in your own and publish. No lorem ipsum, no broken layouts. One simple commercial license, unlimited client sites.
